name: Love For One Another
overview: Scripture commands believers to love one another as an expression of their faith and obedience to God. From Leviticus 19:18, we see the foundation of loving our neighbor as ourselves without holding grudges. Jesus reinforces this in John 13:34-35 by giving a new commandment to love one another as He has loved us, marking true discipleship. This love fulfills the law (Romans 13:8) and calls believers to remain in Christ’s love (John 15:9), demonstrating a Christ-centered, sacrificial love that defines the Christian community.
